name: Lucélia (Brazil)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with a large white star bearing the municipal arms.
history: Lucélia is a municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil. Portuguese Wikipedia records that the coat of arms was instituted by Municipal Law No. 583 of 5 June 1959.

features.role: large star bearing the municipal arms
municipal arms with a mural crown, a blue shield with a red triangle, between branches
